construction.implementation_origin: Original implementation written in this isolated build

input.knowledge: array of unique-id articles: id, title, body, keywords, step_ids

shared_schema.error: status=error and error text; CLI exit 2
shared_schema.validation: Shared validate(kind, value) enforces exact fields, types, nonblank bounded text, unique identifiers, valid steps, stage invariants and cross-stage consistency. JSON duplicate fields and nonfinite numbers are rejected.

cross_stage_handoffs.consumption: Support validates the onboarding output and checks it against the request. Current step breaks retrieval ties and is preserved in the answer; customer, goal and step inform escalation summaries.

behavior.onboarding: Select first incomplete applicable step in order: verify email, set goal, invite team (admins only), start project. Personalize using name and goal; completed customers have no next step.
behavior.support: Case-insensitive token overlap on article titles and keywords. Rank by overlap, then onboarding-step relevance, then original article order. Return the selected body verbatim with its article ID as citation. No match produces an explicit knowledge-gap answer and a live/offline handoff proposal.
behavior.offline: Grounded answers work offline; unresolved requests produce an offline_queue proposal, not an actual submitted ticket.
behavior.determinism: No clock, randomness, persistent state, provider or LLM is used.
behavior.fixtures: All example customer details and knowledge policies are explicitly synthetic.

test_outcomes.cli: passed: example prints one JSON object with status ok and exits 0
test_outcomes.validation_errors: Verified missing file, missing argument, malformed JSON, duplicate JSON fields, nonfinite JSON values and invalid schema return status error and exit 2
